name: ecomapa-frontend
description: EcoMapa - Mapa interactivo de puntos de recoleccion de basura

scripts.deploy: vite build && aws s3 sync dist/ s3://$(grep FrontendBucketName ../backend/cdk-outputs.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '"') --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(grep DistributionId ../backend/cdk-outputs.json 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '"') --paths '/*'
